name: consolidation_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, after a 15-25 spot point directional move, the index frequently enters a 5-10 minute tight consolidation (< 0.1% range) as institutional participants — index arb desks, FII program algos — place large resting limit orders at the consolidation ceiling and floor, absorbing counter-directional flow while filling their own position. At 5-second resolution, the precise bar where these resting limit orders are exhausted is identifiable: close crosses above the consolidation ceiling (or below the floor) simultaneously with a volume surge (1.5x average), signaling that the absorption side is depleted. In the 30-90 seconds that follow, competing momentum algos recognize the breakout and pile in, sustaining the continuation move for 10-20 NIFTY spot points — capturing the first wave before retracement.

indicators.name: roll_high_120
indicators.purpose: 120-bar (10-minute) rolling high defines the consolidation ceiling. Chosen at 10 minutes because that matches the typical institutional order-absorption window before a NIFTY breakout — shorter (5 min) captures noise rather than true absorption; longer (20 min) misses the trade setup by extending the wait too far past entry.

indicators.name: roll_low_120
indicators.purpose: Rolling 10-minute low defines the consolidation floor. Symmetric with roll_high_120 — same rationale.

indicators.name: consol_range_pct
indicators.purpose: Fractional range of the 10-minute window. Threshold 0.1% = ~24 NIFTY points at 24000, meaningfully tighter than typical intraday drift (0.2-0.4%/10min). When this is below threshold, the index is genuinely absorbing rather than trending.

indicators.name: prior_move
indicators.purpose: Return from 20 min ago to 10 min ago — the move that PRECEDED the consolidation. 240-bar lookback is NOT 12x blind scaling: the original used 20-bar 1-min bars (20 minutes) to define a prior move; we use 240 bars (also 20 minutes) because the SAME time window for the prior move creates the same continuation bias. The consolidation lasts 10 min; the prior move should be from the 10 min before that.

indicators.name: vol_sma_120
indicators.purpose: 120-bar volume baseline for breakout volume confirmation. Same window as consolidation so we compare breakout bar volume to the quiet consolidation period volume directly.

conditions: volume > vol_sma_120 * vol_ratio_min (default 1.5x — breakout volume confirms)
buy_ce.confirmation: close crosses ABOVE the 10-min ceiling (not just high) to avoid wicks

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 spot points retrace. A genuine NIFTY breakout should not retrace more than 8 spot points into the consolidation range within 30 seconds — if it does, the limit orders were NOT exhausted and this is a false break. At delta ~0.5, 8 spot pts = 4 option pts.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 spot points continuation. The first wave after a 10-minute consolidation breakout on NIFTY typically extends 12-20 spot points before the first pause. 14 spot pts captures the lower-end reliable portion (avoiding overshoot risk), giving 1:1.75 R:R.

filters.vix_filter: none — consolidation breakouts work across volatility regimes
filters.time_filter: 09:30-14:45 IST; skip first 15 minutes (max_lookback warmup) and avoid last 45 minutes (EOD noise)
filters.volume_filter: breakout bar volume >= 1.5x rolling 10-min average — mandatory for true breakout vs drift
filters.trend_filter: continuation bias: buy CE only if prior move was up; buy PE only if prior move was down
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — as more algos detect consolidation patterns, false breakouts increase; volume filter partially mitigates

adaptation_notes: Key changes from original: (1) Universe shifted from NIFTY200 stocks to NIFTY index — institutional flows dominate NIFTY so absorption thesis is stronger, not weaker; (2) Consolidation window compressed from 20 1-min bars (20 min) to 120 5s-bars (10 min) because at 5s we're trading the first breakout wave (30-90s hold), not the sustained 15-45 min continuation; (3) Range threshold halved from 0.2% to 0.1% because NIFTY index is smoother than individual stocks — 0.2% on NIFTY would include normal drift, not just true consolidation; (4) Prior move threshold lowered from 0.5% to 0.15% because NIFTY moves are naturally dampened vs single stocks; (5) Volume filter ratio lowered from 2x to 1.5x because index volume is noisier at 5s granularity.
weaknesses: NIFTY index volume at 5-second granularity is noisy — volume filter may not reliably distinguish breakouts from random spikes
At 5s bars, close > roll_high can occur frequently in trending markets without being a true 'consolidation breakout' — the prior_move continuation filter is critical but imperfect
10-minute consolidations on NIFTY may coincide with scheduled macro releases (RBI, inflation data) where the breakout is news-driven rather than technical

_source.original_target: measured move (magnitude of prior move projected from breakout)
